## Identity

Karpo Travel Inc. is a personalized travel agency based in Long Island, New York, USA. It works remotely by phone, WhatsApp and email. There is no public storefront.

- Legal name: Karpo Travel Inc.
- Also known as: Karpo Travel, Karpo
- Tagline: Your Journey, Our Priority.
- Founder & Managing Director: Jenson Daniel
- Established: 2026, in New York
- Family travel background: described on the site as starting in the 1960s
- Experience: over 60 years of family experience in the travel industry
- Industry: travel agencies (NAICS 561510)

## Services

Karpo plans six kinds of travel, personally around each client's preferences, pace and priorities.

1. Flights — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/flights
   Route and schedule research, fare and cabin guidance, booking coordination, help with changes.
2. Hotels — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/hotels
   Hotel and resort shortlisting, guidance on location and room type, booking coordination, support while traveling.
3. Vacations — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/vacations
   Vacation concept and itinerary planning, coordination of travel, stays and key experiences, support before and during the trip.
4. Cruises — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/cruises
   Cruise itinerary and cabin guidance, curated sailing options, booking coordination, ongoing support.
5. Cars — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/cars
   Chauffeured and self-drive planning guidance, airport and hotel transfer coordination, clear timing and pickup details.
6. Visa assistance — https://www.karpotravel.com/services/visa-assistance
   Guidance on visa requirements, help organizing documents and next steps, review support for accuracy.

Services index: https://www.karpotravel.com/services

## About

https://www.karpotravel.com/about

Karpo Travel Inc. was founded to make personalized travel simpler, more thoughtful, and more reliable. Drawing on over 60 years of family experience in the travel industry, the practice focuses on carefully planned journeys that reflect each client's preferences, pace, and priorities.

Timeline labels on the About page:
- 1960s — A family built on travel
- 2023 — The personal touch begins
- 2026 — Karpo Travel Inc. is born

Values named on the About page: Personal, Transparent, Reliable, Detail-first.
